rationale: The strengthened blind reconstruction contains the full high-level Banach-space claim: real normed-vector structure, an exact equality to the canonical eLpNorm-based norm for each element, and completeness of the universal set for every exponent p >= 1 including infinity. It also correctly uses almost-everywhere equivalence classes. The round-trip evidence nevertheless leaves two source-critical imported meanings unresolved: finite-exponent eLpNorm' is not expanded to the source's moment/root formula, and IsProbabilityMeasure is interpreted only conventionally. The isolation rule forbids filling those gaps from Lean or prior judgments, so both implications are unclear, the classification is undetermined, and adjudication is required.
